t: This is the Henry Fawcett Memorial, a granite fountain with a bronze panel and portrait medallion above the basin. It was installed in 1886 in Victoria Embankment Gardens, and it's Grade Two listed. It remembers Henry Fawcett, a British academic, statesman and economist. Several hands made it. Basil Champneys was the architect, Mary Grant created the portrait relief, and George Frampton produced the ornamental elements. Grant was one of the most eminent female sculptors of nineteenth-century Britain. Frampton also made the Edith Cavell Memorial in London and the Peter Pan statue in Kensington Gardens.
